apps.title: Invokers: Titan Legacy
apps.summary:
Hack and slash your way through a vibrant fantasy world, battling epic bosses and hundreds of different enemies along the way. Crush waves of skeletons, goblins, and ogres – then face off against fearsome dragons, colossal giants, deadly demons, and much more.

Explore a vast world and discover a huge variety of stunning locations and enemies. Craft your perfect team: summon legendary Invokers and powerful Titans and experience the most exciting Action RPG combat on mobile – this is a true AAA mobile game. Adventure across tons of levels and beat huge dungeon bosses to win the best loot.

COLLECT INVOKERS & TITANS

Summon over a hundred Invokers from a variety of different Factions and customize your fantasy team: play as orcs, elves, humans – or someone a little more furry. And that's not all – summon powerful Titans and bind them to your Invokers to call upon legendary power.

INVOKE TITANS

When the time's right, unleash the ultimate power – Invoke a Titan and transform into a super powered fantasy creature to take down anything that stands in your way.

FIGHT EPIC BOSS BATTLES

Face off against classic monsters and bosses and experience the best boss battles on mobile! Go to war against the terrifying Corrupted Dragon, the cold-hearted Ice Queen, the merciless Demon Lord, and many more – in the best Action MMORPG battles around.

FAST-PACED ACTION COMBAT

Don't waste time taking turns – Invokers: Titan Legacy is all-action, all the time. Invokers takes all the tactics and strategy of turn-based battle RPGs, but boosts the excitement to a new level with fast, flashy, action gameplay.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TEAM

With billions of different team combinations and ways to develop your Invokers, you can play exactly how you want. Equip your team with powerful relics, then upgrade their skills to fit your strategy and tactics – bring deadly attackers, tough tanks, helpful healers, powerful sorcerers, or whatever you need to take down your next target.

CLIMB THE SPIRES

Craft the perfect strategy and build your teams to climb the towers to glory. Each legendary elemental tower requires a fully custom team. Master the elements and claim your victory.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Play how you want – whenever, wherever. Take full control of every Invoker, every skill, and every ability – or play on Auto mode to kick back, relax, and watch your awesome team do their thing.

And no internet, no problem. You can play Invokers offline – no matter where you are in the world. On a plane? At the bottom of the sea? Upgrade your experience with non-stop action-packed Invokers battles.

STUNNING 3D GRAPHICS

From the gorgeous, fully-animated 3D characters to the richly detailed, vibrant biomes, Invokers offers a vivid world you can immerse yourself in. And with thousands of unique skill animations and effects, action RPG combat has never looked more exciting.

EXPLORE A DEEP FANTASY WORLD

Get to know every Invoker in Amara, with fully fleshed out lore and bios for every single character – along with an expansive world map to discover. The world of Invokers is deep, complex, and rich with story.

apps.title: Last One Standing - Celeb Quiz
apps.summary:
Nine celebrities. One question. Who's the tallest?

Tap the faces you think are wrong, one at a time, until there's a single
celeb left standing. Then find out if you were right.

It's the game behind The Daily Upturn's guessing videos, watched by millions.

Everyone in the world gets the same nine faces today. No blaming an easy board.

HOW IT WORKS
The question changes at midnight. Tallest. Richest. Most followed. Oldest.
You get three lives, so you can be wrong twice and still walk away with it.
A round takes about a minute. You'll understand it in five seconds and
still lose.

WHAT'S IN IT
- A new puzzle every day
- Three lives a round
- A streak that gets harder to give up the longer it runs
- Your rank against everyone else who played today
- Coins for a win, and more of them if you're quick
- One skip to spend when a board beats you
- A short tutorial if you want one

SETTLE IT IN THE GROUP CHAT
Share today's result without giving the answer away, and find out who
actually knows their pop culture and who's been guessing the whole time.
New puzzle at midnight.

apps.title: Sector Defense: Roguelike TD
apps.summary:
One soldier. One drone. An alien swarm at the gates.

Sector Defense is a sci-fi tower defense game built around a hero, a combat drone, and the base they must protect. Pick roguelike skills, upgrade your gear, and turn a small fighting force into a wall of firepower.

🛡️ HOLD THE LINE

The aliens are closing in. Stand your ground as waves push toward your base, and shape your tower defense strategy around stopping them before they break through. Your position stays fixed, but your options grow as the battle unfolds.

This is tower defense at close quarters: the next wave is coming down the same battlefield you are fighting to hold. A strong start helps, but survival depends on the choices that follow. Build a defense that can withstand the pressure, then push back against the swarm.

🎯 ONE HERO. ONE COMBAT DRONE.

Your armored soldier is not the only star of the battle. Your combat drone adds its firepower. Both defend your base, giving this alien tower defense game a clear focus: keep your small team strong enough to stop a much larger threat.

Upgrade your equipment and see how your hero and drone fit into your evolving build. Their strength is not just in the weapons they carry, but in the abilities you choose to support them. Build your base defense around this fighting pair and keep the alien bugs away from the gates.

🃏 CHOOSE SKILLS. CHANGE THE BATTLE.

Roguelike tower defense puts decisions in your hands.

- Pick from the skill cards offered during a run, combine abilities, and develop a build that answers the pressure on your base.
- Each selection helps you craft your strategy. The cards offer a limited choice, so you cannot take everything at once.
- Decide which option adds the most to your current setup instead of chasing power that does not fit.

Do you strengthen an ability you already rely on or choose something different? Experiment with skill combinations and watch how they affect the fight. These roguelike decisions give tower defense a new layer of strategy: you are shaping your next answer to the alien horde, one choice at a time.

🔧 UPGRADE BEYOND THE CURRENT FIGHT

In-battle skills shape your current run. Equipment upgrades prepare you for the battles ahead. Keep those two layers working together: develop your roguelike build in combat, then upgrade your gear to strengthen your starting position.

Your tower defense progression is about turning what you learn into a stronger setup. Upgrade your equipment and hammer the alien swarm with greater firepower. Each upgrade gives you more strength to bring back to tower defense battles, while your next set of skill choices determines how you use it.

👾 FACE THE THREAT BEHIND THE SWARM

Alien bosses bring the war to your gates. The enemy is now tougher, and the skills that helped with earlier waves may not be enough. Bring your weapons and abilities together for the moment your defense needs them most.

Boss battles give your tower defense upgrades a purpose beyond bigger numbers. Can your setup withstand the attack, or does it need a different combination? Take what you learn into the next fight and give your hero a better chance of survival when the next boss arrives.

🔥 MAKE YOUR STAND

A hero, a drone, and your choices stand between the alien invasion and your base. Combine roguelike decisions with tower defense progression, strengthen your base defense, and fight for survival. Hold the line, one wave at a time.

apps.title: Hoop Life:Idle Game
apps.summary:
WELCOME TO HOOP STAR: IDLE CLICKER – THE ULTIMATE BASKETBALL RISE!
Step into the world of JORDEN, an unknown street baller with nothing but a worn-out court, a ball, and a dream to become a legend. In this addictive idle clicker and life simulator, you’ll grind your way from street games to the pro stage—rising from “the kid nobody passes to” into a global basketball icon and business tycoon.
FROM STREET COURTS TO THE SPOTLIGHT
JORDEN starts with nothing but grit and determination. Watch his journey from zero to hero as he battles through intense games and relentless training. Every tap brings you closer to turning doubt into dominance and becoming the center of attention on the court.
SHOW YOUR MOVES, OWN THE GAME
Dominate the court with your skills! Hold to dribble, shoot, and dunk your way to highlight plays that fire up the crowd. In intense 1v1 shooting battles, face off against your opponents. Time your shots and score more baskets within the limit to win. Each victory boosts your leaderboard rank, taking you from unknown to the top.
BUILD YOUR BASKETBALL EMPIRE
As your fame grows, so does your income. Upgrade elite training facilities, unlock stylish gear and signature sneakers, and refine your skills to perfection. Balance training and competition to turn JORDEN into not just a star player—but a true business powerhouse.
LIVE THE PRO PLAYER LIFE
This is more than just basketball—it’s a full life simulation. Meet teammates, face rivals, handle pressure, and make key decisions that shape your career. Will you rise to MVP greatness or fade as a one-hit wonder? The choice is yours.
KEY FEATURES:
● Highlight Plays: Perform flashy moves and dominate the crowd
● Idle Progression: Train and earn rewards even while offline
● Tycoon System: Upgrade facilities, gear, and performance
● Life Simulator: Experience the highs and lows of a pro career
● Rise to Glory: Go from street baller to global legend
● Star Journey: Build your fame, skills, and legacy

apps.title: Domino Blast: Block Puzzle
apps.summary:
Drop blocks. Clear a line. Watch the dominoes fall!

Domino Blast is a colourful block puzzle with a twist. Drag block pieces onto an 8x8 board to fill rows and columns. The dominoes standing on the board count as filled cells too.

Complete a line with a domino in it and the domino tips over. It rushes across the board along its arrow, smashes every block in its path and knocks over the next domino. Chains turn corners, and the fallen dominoes can complete even more lines. One smart move can set off a huge chain reaction.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a piece from the tray onto the board
• Fill a full row or column to clear it
• Topple the dominoes and let the chain do the rest
• Free every domino, or smash the target number of blocks, to clear the level
• No piece fits? You're out of room. Try again, or call in a Domino Drop

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• One simple move, easy to learn in seconds
• Big chain reactions with bursts, shakes and rising combo sounds
• Bright, glossy candy colours that are easy to read
• Short levels that flow straight into the next one
• Rainbow dominoes that tip in every direction
• A reward chest every few levels
• Endless levels: ice blocks, bombs and stone walls join the board as you go
• Boss levels with giant chains, and a fresh world look every 40 levels
• Plays offline, no Wi-Fi needed (ads and ad rewards need a connection)

Domino Blast is free to play. It contains ads, including optional reward ads.

Line up the pieces, tip the first domino and blast the board clean!

apps.summary:

Welcome to the FDI, Mr Tanner.

Time to clear your head, work through your hangover and start your first day as an Operator. There are plenty of cases to solve. Assist our field agents using your computer console and ingenuity to bring criminals to justice. Ready to make the world a better place?

Investigate Crimes: Solve cases such as murders, missing people, and cyber attacks.
Use FDI Software: Analyze evidence and find clues using cutting-edge tools.
Dig Deeper: Follow the evidence as it twists and turns, no matter where it leads.
Uncover the Truth: Each case is a mind-bending story to unravel, so take notes.

Assist Our Field Agents
When our field agents need support, they'll call you. Help them by fact-checking, searching databases, identifying killers, and more. Each case will have evidence to evaluate, and it's your job to dig into documents, connect the clues, and solve the mysteries.

Cutting-Edge Software
You have the finest FDI software to help with those challenging cases. Tap through the Video and Photo Analyzer, Citizen and Vehicle Database, ChemScan, Notepad and a fully functional Terminal at any point to find out what you need.

In Truth, We Seek
To find the truth, you must follow the evidence and see where it leads, no matter how unsettling. But don't poke into unauthorized areas without first notifying your superiors.

FDI's Most Wanted
WARNING: Any new information on the cyber criminal known as HAL should be reported to your supervisor immediately. For the safety of the general public and your fellow agents, please keep all evidence confidential.

///// TRUST NO ONE /////
[End Transmission]

apps.title: Click Match
apps.summary:
Click Match – Relaxing Mahjong Tile Matching Puzzle
Click Match is a calm yet engaging mahjong solitaire puzzle that brings classic tile matching together with a clean, modern design. Large, easy-to-read tiles and simple controls make every board comfortable to enjoy on both phones and tablets.
Whether you want a peaceful break or a satisfying daily puzzle, Click Match lets you play at your own pace. It is welcoming for new players, longtime puzzle fans, and older adults who prefer clear visuals and low-pressure gameplay.

How to Play
Find two identical free tiles and tap them to remove the pair. A tile can be selected when it is not covered and has an open side. Keep matching pairs until the board is clear.

Game Features
● Classic Mahjong Solitaire – Familiar pair-matching rules that are easy to learn.
● Large & Clear Tiles – Comfortable visuals and readable text for relaxed play.
● Play at Your Own Pace – No timer pressure; pause and return whenever you like.
● Mindful Puzzles – Enjoy a gentle challenge for focus and logical thinking.
● Satisfying Combos – Build matching streaks and enjoy smooth visual feedback.
● Helpful Tools – Use hints, undo, and shuffle when a board becomes tricky.
● Offline Play – Enjoy tile-matching puzzles without an internet connection.
● Phone & Tablet Support – A smooth experience across different screen sizes.
Click Match combines the familiar comfort of mahjong solitaire with clear design and relaxing puzzle play. Match tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a quiet moment whenever it fits your day.
Note: Click Match is a Mahjong Solitaire-style tile-matching puzzle. It does not use the rules of traditional four-player mahjong or card solitaire; “mahjong” refers to the visual style of the tiles.

Complete every area to finish the artwork

Download Santa Color and bring Christmas pictures to life with every tap.

apps.title: Book Solitaire: Associations
apps.summary:
Every book hides a category. Every reader wants one.

Welcome to the Storywood Library. Each book shows a word or a picture — and every one belongs to a secret category. Trees. Cheeses. Cities. Animals. Emotions. Spot the link, stack the books that go together, and fill every library guest's order before your moves run out.

No timers, no reflexes — just that click in your brain when the words snap into place.

HOW TO PLAY

- Every book belongs to a reader's category
- Drag books onto each other to build matching stacks
- Fill each reader's order to send them home happy
- Clear the library level before your moves run out
- Undo and hint boosters for when a puzzle gets tight

FEATURES

- Hundreds of association puzzles, from gentle to genuinely brain-bending
- Words and pictures to connect: food, animals, geography, myth, science, sport
- A warm, hand-illustrated library full of charming readers

A little bit solitaire, a little bit associations. Start sorting now!

apps.title: Arrow Cash Rush
apps.summary:
Arrow Cash Rush is an arrow puzzle game where each level shows a puzzle board made of arrow paths, turns, and maze-style routes. Read the arrow direction, choose the next path, and clear every arrow puzzle board with careful logic.

The core experience is simple: look at the full board, follow the arrowheads, and decide which route should be solved first. Some arrow puzzle boards open quickly, while other line puzzle layouts ask you to compare turns, trace blocked routes, and plan the next move before the path gets harder to read.

🎮 How to Play

Start each level by scanning the puzzle board. Check where every arrow points, follow open routes, avoid blocked turns, and solve the path puzzle one step at a time. A clean choice can open a new route, while the wrong order may make the arrow puzzle board harder to solve.

Use logic puzzle thinking when the arrow maze becomes more complex. Compare each arrow puzzle route, decide which path should be cleared first, and keep working until the maze puzzle layout is solved and the next board is ready.

✨ Main Features

  • ➡️ Clear Arrow Puzzle Goal - Read arrow directions, choose a route order, and solve each arrow puzzle board.

  • 🧩 Path Puzzle Planning - Study each path puzzle layout, trace the open path, and avoid blocked turns.

  • 🌀 Maze Puzzle Layouts - Explore maze puzzle routes, arrow maze turns, and line puzzle boards with clear objectives.

  • 💡 Logic Puzzle Solving - Use observation, order planning, and brain teaser focus to decide the next correct path.

  • 🎁 Bright In-Game Theme - Enjoy coins, treasure chests, colorful arrows, and cheerful progress moments while the gameplay stays focused on puzzle solving.


Arrow Cash Rush is designed for quick puzzle board sessions. The rules are easy to learn: read the arrows, follow the path, clear the board, and move to the next arrow puzzle challenge.

If you enjoy maze puzzle layouts, brain teaser routes, and simple logic puzzle solving, this arrow puzzle offers a clear board-solving loop built around direction, order, and route planning.

Play Arrow Cash Rush, follow the arrows, choose the right arrow puzzle path, and enjoy each clever route challenge.

Liquid Vial is a calm, one-finger water sort puzzle. Each tap pours the top layer of one tube into another, and the goal never changes: end every tube holding one clean, single color. No timers, no lives, no punishment for thinking.

HOW TO PLAY • Tap one tube, then tap another to pour. • Pour onto an empty tube or onto the same color only. • Each tube holds four layers; a legal pour moves as much as fits. • Clear the level when every tube is a single pure color.
3,500+ LEVELS, EVERY ONE VERIFIED • 3,586 main levels, each validated by our solver before it ships. • No repeated layouts — every board is normalized and de-duplicated. • Difficulty ramps from 2-4 colors in the first ten levels to 11-12 in the challenge range. • Every level is solvable. If you get stuck, the board is at fault, not you.

HIDDEN COLORS Some tubes hide their true colors and show only what the top layer reveals; pour it out and what was buried appears. A simple sort becomes a test of memory and planning.

apps.title: Age of Spirits
apps.summary:
Long before kingdoms rose and steel was forged, the world belonged to the dark. Beneath a cold canopy of bone and ash, primitive savages huddled around scattered hearth-fires, listening for the whispers of the Old Ones, the ancient wicked gods who hungered for living warmth and dragged the souls of the weak into the underworld. Most clans flickered out before the first dawn. A few endured. And then, the spirits sent a Chief.

You are that Chief, the one whose will guides the people from above the firelight. Though you do not lift the spear yourself, every shaman you awaken bears your command, every villager labors by your decree, and every hearth-fire that burns is kindled because you have decided it should. From the high seat of an isolated tribe at the edge of the dark, you must reclaim wandering savages, summon legendary heroes to lead your warbands, build the first true settlement the Wilds have ever known, and forge a people strong enough to outlive the night.

Age of Spirits is a strategy game of awakening, ritual, and primal resolve. Will you raise tall stones around your hearth-fire and grow your tribe into a city of rites and crafts, or will you march your warbands deep into ancestral grounds to seize what only the bravest can win? The ancestors are watching. The Old Ones are stirring. The spark of all that is to come rests in your hands. Do you have the will to lead the first tribe into a new age?

GAME FEATURES

Awaken Savages, Bestow Wisdom: Bring untamed savages from the deep Wilds to your hearth-fire and awaken them as villagers. Assign your people to every post that matters, gathering, hunting, crafting, and tending the rites. Watching each pair of hands turn raw labor into the resources that grow your tribe.

Lead Expeditions, Claim the Spoils: Command your heroes on expeditions deep into ancestral grounds. Face perilous trials in turn-based combat, defeat champions of the dark, and bring home precious bounties and the rare materials no settlement can rise without.

Summon Legendary Heroes: Summon spirit-touched champions, such as fierce hunters, far-sighted wizards, and bone-clad guardians, to serve as the heroes of your tribe. Promote and equip them with ancestral weapons and ritual gear, then send your strongest to lead every march and stand at the front of every fight.

Build Your Tribe from a Single Fire: Raise your settlement from a circle of stones into a thriving tribe. Kindle the central hearth, consecrate altars of wisdom and faith, sink quarries and woodyards, train new warriors, and upgrade every structure to unlock new units, rites, and strength.

Challenge Across the World Map: March your armies across a vast living world. Lay claim to resource grounds, raid rival tribes, contest sacred lands, defeat field bosses, and write your name on the map in flame and stone.

Join Forces with Alliances: Form alliances with players from across the world. Coordinate strategies, share resources, defend each other's lands, and wage large-scale battles together against rival forces.

· Network connection is required.

• Dynamic reputation system
• A dark story of resurrection and revenge

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

apps.title: Bungee Beat
apps.summary:
Bungee Beat is a physics-based action game built around elastic gum.
Aim and fire gum at enemies, walls, and movable objects to create connections. The connected targets react to movement, weight, and gum tension.
Use the environment and different connection points to affect enemies and clear each stage. Enemy movement and object reactions are controlled by ragdoll and physics systems, so the result changes depending on where the gum is attached.
Use simple touch controls to aim, fire, and manage placed gum. Progress through stages and try different connections to complete each encounter.

🎯 Rummy 500 is a popular classic card game for players of all ages — from beginners and casual players to seniors and longtime card game fans. Enjoy classic Rummy 500 anytime on your phone or tablet, with standard Rummy 500 rules and scoring, smart AI opponents, and smooth offline gameplay.

Whether you are relaxing while watching TV, winding down before bed, passing the time, or training your brain with a rewarding challenge, this classic offline card game is always ready to play — no wifi or mobile data required.

The goal is simple: empty your hand before your opponents and be the first to reach 500 points!

Draw cards, build sets and runs, lay off cards onto existing melds, and make smart discards to stay ahead of your opponents. Use Jokers wisely to create more possibilities and plan each move carefully as you race to 500 points.

- Sort and rearrange your hand, use unlimited smart hints to find better moves, and enjoy unlimited undos when you want to fix a mistake. These helpful tools make it easier to form melds and avoid misplays.

Jokers Add More Strategy
- Use Jokers as wild cards to create more meld possibilities and unlock flexible strategies. Every hand becomes more fun, more unpredictable, and more rewarding.

Leagues & Special Events
- Progress from Bronze to Silver and toward Legendary Master at your own pace. Complete special event goals and keep making progress with every game.

Rich Rewards
- Earn coins, unlock card styles, and collect limited-time rewards through daily tasks and events.

Statistics & Game History
- Track your progress with game history and detailed statistics after each round. Review your performance, improve your strategy, and keep building your Rummy 500 skills.

apps.title: Aniimo
apps.summary:
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. On the vast continent of Idyll, you'll encounter countless unique creatures known as Aniimo. Twine with them and experience the beauty of this world from a completely new perspective and with new abilities.
You can also travel to a metropolis floating in the sky, where you'll meet other Pathfinders, share stories, and engage in thrilling competitive battles. Choose your Aniimo and embark on an epic journey - one full of exploration, discovery, and adventure!

Seize every chance to capture and collect Aniimo to your heart's desire!

When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

Twine with Aniimo to feel the world like they do

On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

Jump into the adventure and enjoy exploring an expansive open world

The continent of Idyll is expansive and alive with beauty and the perfect setting to capture, to Twine, to find answers and for the Aniimo to reach their full potential. Challenge, race, discover... immersive exploration ensures every step of the journey is engaging. Whether you're gliding, diving, burrowing... you can step foot anywhere.

Join exciting real-time challenges with Aniimo

In the vast world of Aniimo, every real-time challenge is full of unknowns and surprises. The PVEVP mode "Egg Heist" allows you to join a 3-player team anytime to engage in real-time searches and battles in the Lost Isles.
Whether you're solo, multiplayer, adventuring, battling, or simply looking to quickly become stronger, here, every challenge is real and instantaneous!

Enjoying camping and roadtrips with your friends

Each Pathfinder now owns a personal RV on the vast continent of Idyll, parked at a campsite in this open world, where they can meet and interact with other players. When you return to Homeland with your RV, you can plant crops, build decorations, and freely arrange your space with Aniimo to transform the entire Homeland into a warm, fun, and interactive immersive paradise.

apps.title: AI Dungeon Master & RPG Fablia
apps.summary:
Fablia is an AI Dungeon Master that runs a fantasy RPG built around you. No group to schedule, no rulebook to memorise, no waiting for anyone else. Describe what your hero does, and the AI narrates what happens next.

A DUNGEON MASTER THAT NEVER RUNS OUT OF STORY
Type any action and the AI Dungeon Master answers it. Talk your way past the gate guards, torch the tavern, spare the bandit who begged, or walk away from the whole quest. The story bends around your choice and remembers what you did. No two runs tell the same tale, because nothing is scripted.

TWO WAYS TO BEGIN YOUR QUEST
• Quick Play — choose your character and story, and the adventure begins
• Custom Game — create your own story, set the rules and build your world: write its laws, seed the people who matter, and tell the Dungeon Master exactly how to run it

ROLL THE DICE AND LIVE WITH IT
Skill checks are settled the tabletop way, with a real D20 roll rendered in 3D with sound and haptics. Beat the target and you stay on your feet. Miss it and fortune turns against you. Push your luck too far and you are rolling a death save.

YOUR HERO, YOUR RECORD
• Character sheet tracking stats, skills and gear
• Codex that fills in with the lore, people and places you uncover
• Chronicle of every scene in your campaign
• Multiple save slots, so several adventures can run side by side

BE ANYONE, WITH NO LIMITS
Play the knight who keeps their oath or the one who breaks it. Be a scheming merchant, a hedge witch, a deserter, a god-touched fool. The AI roleplay adapts to the character you actually write, not a class you picked from a list.

WHY PLAYERS PICK FABLIA
• A solo RPG you can play in five minutes or five hours
• Interactive fiction with real consequences, not a branching menu
• A text adventure where you type freely instead of tapping preset replies
• A choose your own adventure engine that never repeats itself
• Tabletop-style dungeon crawling without needing a party

WHAT YOU CAN DO
Explore ruined keeps and drowned shrines. Bargain, bluff and threaten your way through encounters. Recruit companions and lose them. Build a hero from nothing and watch the world start reacting to your name. Or throw all of it out and build a world of your own in Custom Game, down to how the Dungeon Master should narrate it.

Fablia is for anyone who loves fantasy RPG storytelling, interactive story games, AI roleplay, dungeon master simulators, text adventures and classic tabletop roleplaying, but wants it available the moment the mood strikes.

Your world is unwritten. Begin your quest.
